d: Lionel Messi is still producing remarkable numbers at 39, and his latest performance for Inter Miami has brought the Ballon d’Or conversation back into focus. From his stunning display against Atlanta United to the question of how his achievements compare with other contenders like Harry Kane and Lamine Yamal, Messi continues to give football fans plenty to debate. But beyond the goals and assists, what keeps one of football’s greatest players pushing forward at this stage of his career? Rupha Ramani explores Messi’s extraordinary form since the FIFA World Cup 2026, his Ballon d’Or…
